purpose: Define reusable technology-integration axes and pairing rules so future checkpoints can extend shared scenario matrices instead of creating wholly bespoke studies.

pairedComparison.note: The integrated runner derives identical trial streams for all variants sharing comparisonGroup; CP81 deliberately holds the stream fixed across the four EW packages and both +10/+12 computer candidates within each combat/geometry context.

extensionPolicy: Extend shared axes only when the additional dimension is relevant to a changed dependency.
Keep pairwise or factorial blocks small enough that causal attribution remains interpretable.
Use actual-consumer preflight and one-trial full-pipeline smoke before substantive Monte Carlo.
Do not convert outcome targets into automatic promotion gates; balance remains human-reviewed evidence.
